digest.component_or_area: agent guidance and tool selection workflow
propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena symbol tools despite documentation because grep requires zero friction while Serena incurs a ToolSearch discovery round-trip cost

Serena cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (getattr, monkeypatch.setattr, importlib patterns), yet grep can find them; a rule favoring Serena exclusively would miss real call sites that fail in CI
The guidance in AGENTS.md lacks moment-specific triggers and feedback; standing dispositions in static documentation decay in salience across multi-turn sessions with working-memory dominance
Serena's LSP index can lag behind recent edits and reports stale line numbers, while grep searches the current tree but produces false positives in comments that Serena filters

The three root causes require structural solutions: re-surface Serena at grep invocation time via a PreToolUse hook, eliminate the discovery-cost friction by disabling tool search, and encode the corrected division of labour (structural rule, not exhortation) in both AGENTS.md and project-overlay coaching moves
